title: At the restaurant
scenario: You are in a customer role. Use English naturally in this restaurant situation.

lines.text: Good afternoon. Could we have the bill, please?
Of course. Was everything satisfactory today?
The food was excellent, but the service was a bit slow.
I apologise for that. We were very busy this evening.
I understand. The quality makes up for it.
If you sign up for our membership, you will receive a discount.
That sounds worthwhile. I often dine here.
Wonderful. I will bring you the application form.
